# victorops_user_contact_email (Resource)

Manages an email contact method for a VictorOps user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_user_contact_email" "jdane_work" {
  username = victorops_user.jdane.user_name
  email    = "jdane-alerts@example.com"
  label    = "Work Email"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address.
- `label` (String) A label for this email contact (e.g., 'Work Email', 'Personal Email').
- `username` (String) The username of the user this contact email belongs to.

### Optional

- `rank` (Number) The rank (priority) of this contact method.

### Read-Only

- `ext_id` (String) The external ID of the contact.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import victorops_user_contact_email.jdane_work <username>/<ext_id>
```
